findings.evidence: Filtration.lean:116-117 `def filtration (Q) (k) := TauCeti.Algebra.wordFiltration (ι Q) k`; Filtration.lean:129-130 same for `filtrationPrevious`; Filtration.lean:238-240 `mul_mem_filtration ... := TauCeti.Algebra.mul_mem_wordFiltration (ι Q) hx hy`; AssociatedGraded.lean:10 already imports that file; grep shows the new bridges are used only at AssociatedGraded.lean:113-116,131-134.
findings.fix: Delete both private bridge lemmas and the `rw` plumbing at lines 113-117 and 131-135; add public `mul_mem_filtrationPrevious_left`/`mul_mem_filtrationPrevious_right` to CliffordAlgebra/Filtration.lean next to `mul_mem_filtration`, each as `TauCeti.Algebra.mul_mem_wordFiltrationPrevious_left (ι Q) hx hy` / `..._right (ι Q) hx hy` (the bridges are `rfl`, since `filtration Q k` is *defined* as `wordFiltration (ι Q) k` at Filtration.lean:116-117), and call them from AssociatedGraded.
findings.issue: `filtration_eq_wordFiltration` and `filtrationPrevious_eq_wordFiltrationPrevious` are private bridge lemmas in a consumer file; the Clifford analogue of the new generic lemmas belongs in the earlier `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/CliffordAlgebra/Filtration.lean`, which defines `filtration`/`filtrationPrevious` and already specializes every generic word-filtration lemma (e.g. `mul_mem_filtration` at Filtration.lean:238-240). This is also the asymmetry with the PBW half of this PR, which correctly adds `mul_mem_pbwFiltrationPrevious_left/right` to UniversalEnveloping/Filtration.lean.

summary: The new PBW/LeadingTerm.lean file and the generic WordFiltration additions are placed correctly, but the Clifford-side rework puts the filtration-drop reasoning in the downstream consumer AssociatedGraded.lean as private bridge lemmas instead of specializing it in the earlier CliffordAlgebra/Filtration.lean, where every other specialization of the generic word-filtration API lives.
